verdict.rationale: Slack's own AI feature page directly states that AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps, which covers every element of the story. The separate 'Today' briefing adds an AI digest of what needs attention. Support rests on marketing-level claims only. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how summaries and recaps work (scope, time ranges, plan availability), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries and recaps of channels and threads I missed

citations.quote: AI in Slack can summarize channels and threads and serve up daily recaps, giving you the information you need to stay organized and in the know.
Today is your new intelligent briefing that signals what needs your attention based on your priorities.
